sources: https://koa.com/campgrounds/whitefish/reserve/ (KOA booking form: RV, 2 adults, 23-ft motorhome, no slide-outs, 2027-06-15 to 06-16, read in a browser)

values.note: KOA booking form, 1 night 2027-06-15 (Tue), 23-ft motorhome, before tax: pull-thru 30/20-amp water/electric $105; back-in 30/20-amp water/electric $110; 30/20-amp full hookups $130; 50-amp full hookups $135-145; 50-amp full-hookup patio sites $145-155.

fees.source: https://koa.com/campgrounds/whitefish/reserve/ (step 2 site list, '$105.00 avg/night | Pull Thru, 30/20 Amps, Water/Electric' ... '$155.00 avg/night | Pull Thru, 50/30/20 Amps, Full Hookups, Patio'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://koa.com/campgrounds/whitefish/amenities/ ('50 Max Amp') + booking form site types ('50/30/20 Amps, Full Hookups', '30/20 Amps, Water/Electric'), read 2026-10-22

sites.source: https://koa.com/campgrounds/whitefish/ ("90' Max Length"; 'Max pull thru: 100 feet') + booking form ('Pull Thru' site types), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Indoor/outdoor pool (Memorial Day - Labor Day weekends), snack bar/Buffalo Bob's restaurant with free hot breakfast Memorial Day through Labor Day, Kamping Kitchen, propane, firewood, game room, mini golf, playground. Recent reviews say the Wi-Fi is weak and cell service minimal.

facilities.source: https://koa.com/campgrounds/whitefish/amenities/ ('Wi-Fi', 'Pool (5/15 - 9/15)', 'Snack Bar', 'Propane', 'Kamping Kitchen', 'Mini Golf', 'Firewood', 'Game Room') + https://koa.com/campgrounds/whitefish/ ('Buffalo Bob's Family Entertainment Center ... free hot breakfast Memorial Day through Labor Day'), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://koa.com/campgrounds/whitefish/ ('WE'RE OPEN TO CAMPERS BETWEEN MAY 15 AND SEPTEMBER 15'; 'Open May 15 to September 15'), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://koa.com/campgrounds/whitefish/ ('Reserve: 1-800-562-8734', 'Info: 1-406-862-4242') + the working reserve form, read 2026-10-22

note: KOA in the pines off US-93 between Whitefish and Kalispell (33 wooded acres), about 31 km from Glacier's West Entrance. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on koa.com and its booking form: reservable online, water and sewer, pull-throughs. Added $105-155 (mid-June 2027 weeknight, before tax), 50-amp, 90-ft max length, Wi-Fi/pool/snack bar, season May 15 - Sep 15. Phone 406-862-4242 confirmed (reservations 1-800-562-8734). Not stated: site count, showers/laundry/store as listed amenities, Good Sam/military (derived values left). Note trimmed of the hookup, price and rating lines.
flags: Price gate: base $105/night (pull-thru water/electric, mid-June 2027 weeknight) is over US$50; the Glacier NP gateway applies (31 km, gateways.py), as the inclusion evidence already says.
